book.name: Hibulu
book.title: Me niŋdi Hibulu metamdok mede youyemguk

content: Mede Momooŋ nihitubu-lodadok uyadi nadihinaka titiŋdok
Unduŋ doktiŋa indi Mede Momooŋ nadigumun wondok nadinadiŋale gigine tiŋa uŋakoŋ nadikahile tineem, unduŋ tiŋa mu gweheyeeŋ maneem.
Judahi’walaŋ Yodoko Mede aŋelo hekidi yohautagiŋ uyadi fafaŋeŋ hakuk doktiŋa mede u lahukiŋ be mede u wobugiŋ adi yadi kibikoŋ wondok tuwolit begiŋ.

Unduŋ doktiŋa nihitutumbadok Mede Momooŋ loloŋnit i nadigweheye tineem adi wondok kibikoŋ didimeniŋ hinek beneem. Uyadi Wapum negoŋ koom yobihikuk, kaŋ magihikdi hinek nadigiŋ adi yofafaŋeune nadinene biyagoŋ hinek tuguk.
Kaŋ Bepaŋ nebo saŋiniŋ eŋ ne’walaŋ kudiŋiŋ tiŋa kasop ulihiguk. Tiŋa nadihebet halimilak u takaliŋa Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli diniŋ siloŋ daneeŋ molomolom nimguk.
Jesu adi nai muniniŋ-kabe aŋelo heki’walaŋ hebehik foloŋ hatiguk
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, hatihati kobuli diniŋ yokwet kougoŋ mintawaak wendok medeŋiŋ nadiyam, uyadi Bepaŋdi aŋelo hekiyeŋ kadokodok mu yoguk.
Uyadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai-me niŋdi indiŋ yohautaguk hatak,

content.text: “Me indi dediniŋgoŋ hinek doktiŋa inditok nadinimulaŋ? Indi maŋgoŋ biyagoŋ doktiŋa du momooŋ hinek nibudokolaŋ?
Du nai muniniŋ-kabe aŋelo heki’walaŋ hebehik foloŋ fofoŋhinit nipmeguŋ. Tiŋa ninintiŋalooŋ wotnenikgigit loloŋnit nimguŋ.
Du nemenemek hogohogok u yehitubumintaaŋ yabudokodok ninindapmaguŋ.”

content: Adi “nemenemek hogohogok yabudokodok” youkuk, uyadi dane mu tiŋa kunilit yodapmaguk. Iŋgoŋ nai indidegoŋ adi folooŋ mu kayam.

Jesu adigili kayam, adi nai muniniŋ-kabe aŋelo heki’walaŋ hebehik foloŋ hatiŋa kumuŋ diniŋ folofigita nadiguk doktiŋa Bepaŋdi nintilooŋ hauta eŋ wougigit miŋguk hatilak. Adi Bepaŋdi siloŋ tobogoŋ tinimdok yobune biyagoŋ hinek kwetfoloŋ meeniŋ hogohogok inditok kumuŋguk.
Jesu adi noliŋiye niniŋdok nadibedi mu tilak

Nemenemek hogohogok tubumintaguk eŋ wondiniŋ molom adi yadi wapmihiŋiye feedi hauta momooŋ gineŋ hatidok nadiŋa tubulodanik datnik biyeniŋ adi folofigita naditauyeŋ fek foloŋgoŋ usuwadok nindapmaguk. Bepaŋ adi unduŋ tubune tuwot hinek tuguk.
Unduŋ doktiŋa welehik youtewalanda kwanai tilak nebe, be walanda tiiŋ adi yadi behik kubugoŋ, ale notneye yenindok nadibedi mu tilak.
Biyagoŋ hinek, medeŋiŋ indiŋ hatak.

content.text: “Nu du’walaŋ wohoge notneye yenihautawit. Kayoŋbop fee lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ ganiutumbawit.”

content: Tiŋa niŋ indiŋ,
Tiŋa niŋ indiŋ yoguk,

content.text: “Yoŋ adi na eŋ wapmihi Bepaŋdi namuŋguk wanaŋ hatiyam.”

content: Jesu adi indi nihitubu-lodadok sigiŋ gitnemnit hinek mintaguk

Wapmihidok yoguk woŋ adi kwetfoloŋ metam inditok nadiŋa yoguk. Ala indiŋ nadinim. Wapmihi adi meeniŋ hinek doktiŋa adi maaŋ undugoŋ tuguk. Biyagoŋ hinek kuyoŋ, uyadi ne’walaŋ kumuŋŋiŋdi kumuŋ molom Sadaŋ ula saŋiniŋŋiŋ ulatifodapmaguk.
Tiŋa indiŋ maaŋ nadinim, kumuŋdok muntadi yehitehiune wondiniŋ folok gineŋ hakiŋ adi maaŋ fiyakuyemdok nadiŋa unduŋ tuguk.
Uyadi aŋelo heki mu yehitubu-lodalak, adi yadi Abalaham’walaŋ yalakiŋiye indi-ku nihitubu-lodalak oŋ.

Biyagoŋ hinek, unduŋ degoŋ tiŋa kwayaŋye indut foloonik be nadinadinik be welenik kiutnene kubugoŋ titiŋdok nindapmaguk, talik noli nimaaŋ nemu hakuk. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, uyadi siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ wapumdi kulemaŋgoŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ foloŋ kwanai tubune metam indi’walaŋ yomnik youtewalandakutdok mintaguk hatilak.
Adi ne tikamanda eŋ folofigita mintamimbune kakiyondaaŋ kelekufakuk doktiŋa meeniŋ indibo tikamanda eŋ folofigita mintanimbune kedem nihitubu-lodalak.
